access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='ma_smith@gmail.com', password='XjuXZ2Q')['access_token']
# fetch playlist song ids from previous run
playlist_ids=[399,401,396,397,398,395,400]
playlist_details=[]
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    playlist_details.append(pl)

all_song_ids=[]
for pl in playlist_details:
    all_song_ids.extend([s['id'] for s in pl.get('songs',[])])
unique_song_ids=sorted(set(all_song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids', len(unique_song_ids))

indie_song_ids=[]
indie_song_info=[]
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    # song genre string
    genre=str(song.get('genre',''))
    if 'indie' in genre.lower():
        indie_song_ids.append(sid)
        indie_song_info.append({
            'song_id': sid,
            'title': song.get('title'),
            'genre': song.get('genre'),
            'artist_ids': [a['id'] for a in song.get('artists',[])],
            'artist_names': [a.get('name') for a in song.get('artists',[])]
        })
print('indie_song_count', len(indie_song_ids))
print('indie_song_ids', indie_song_ids)
print('indie_song_info', indie_song_info)
